name: Offending People
overview: Scripture acknowledges that offenses are inevitable in human relationships, as Jesus warns that stumbling blocks will come, but it condemns those who cause them. Believers are called to act with love and charity, avoiding actions that grieve or harm their brothers for whom Christ died. The tension between blessing God and cursing others, who bear God's image, highlights the seriousness of offending people. Ultimately, God’s deliverance of the needy reminds us to care for the vulnerable rather than cause them to stumble.
